examples/complex.why:
MathJax can't parse the macros that split comma-separated arguments (\cvc, \rvc, \mat and \passtonextarg), and the build can't see the large operators a command of the document's defines (\Sum and co.); tex4ht writes a stray

in a multicols of listings, so make4ht reads the page as HTML, as a browser does
allow: left undefined for MathJax, which can't read their definitions: \cvc
15 macro(s) MathJax doesn't know, shown in red: \Capp, \Coprod, \Cupp, \Kupp, \Odot, \Oplus, \Otimes, \Prod, \Sum, \Uplus, \Vee, \Wedge, \cvc, \mat, \rvc.

test-units-nocolor.why: siunitx.4ht loads the color package after tex4ht has configured the packages, so the page has no colors; tex8web says so, and that xcolor is needed
allow: Package tex8web Warning: The color package was loaded after the preamble

test-tikzbox.why: tex4ht's TikZ driver (pgfsys-dvisvgm4ht.def) puts two spaces in a \tikz picture's box, so \resizebox makes the picture 1.2% narrower than in the PDF; an \includegraphics in a \scalebox or \resizebox keeps the width of its own options, since text.pictures multiplies only the widths of dvisvgm's pictures
